title: Bound Demon in Chaos
description: A large black fluffy creature with glowing white eyes, one white feathered angel wing and one red demonic bat wing, is entangled in barbed wire while a blindfolded man struggles in front of it. A wooden table in the foreground holds a glowing blue potion, spilled bottles, syringes, and blood.
prompt: A surreal dark fantasy scene featuring a giant black fluffy monster with huge glowing white eyes, sharp teeth, one large white angelic wing and one red demonic bat wing, wrapped in red barbed wire. A blindfolded man in dark clothes is tangled in the wire in front of the creature. Foreground wooden table with glowing blue potion, broken bottles, syringes, spilled liquid and blood. Ghostly white figures stand near a ruined temple under a blood red moon in the background, dramatic blue energy swirls, dark moody atmosphere.
